claims.text: Over the 7 days from the patch, the positive share was +0.7 points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch (90% range -17.8 to +19.3). That isn't enough to credit the patch: its 90% range includes no change at all.
Negative reviews mentioning performance rose by 9.77 percentage points in the window compared to the baseline.
Players reported severe performance drops and stuttering after updates.
Sale days and discount days were 0 during the window.
Off-topic negative review share changed by -0.32 percentage points.
Composition contributed 4.85 points to the sentiment change.
Within-group sentiment changed by 14.76 points across the buckets.

report.summary: Over the 7 days from the patch, the positive share was +0.75 percentage points against the estimate without it. Negative reviews mentioning performance rose by 9.77 percentage points in the window compared to the baseline, and players reported severe performance drops and stuttering after updates. Sale days and discount days were 0.0 reviews during the window. Off-topic negative review share changed by -0.32 percentage points. Composition contributed 4.85 points to the sentiment change, while within-group sentiment changed by 14.76 points across the buckets. The patch, a price change or sale, and a change in who reviewed are inconclusive. Off-topic reviews or a review bomb and noise or seasonality are rejected.
